messages:
Sam: FYI customer reported being billed twice after a streaming session resumed + a tool call. Console shows provisional charge then a final that didn't net out. Anyone seen this? @Priya
Priya: ugh. any logs/trace ids?
Sam: pasted logs below. session_id=ss-9a3, request_id=req-55b
```
INFO streaming resumed session=ss-9a3 request_id=req-55b offset=204
PROVISIONAL_CHARGE user=acct-777 tokens=120 provisional_id=pv-12
TOOLCALL invoked tool=code-runner request=req-55b tokens=40
FINAL_CHARGE user=acct-777 tokens=160 final_id=fn-98 balance_adjust=0
```
Sam: final didn't deduct provisional, ledger shows two lines.
Alex: I can repro locally when a reconnect happens during an in-flight toolcall. Looks like resume heartbeats create a new provisional entry with a different prefix capture window.
Kim: Observability: I see 3 similar prod spikes last week for the same model route. Metrics: provisional_count up, final_count up, but reconciled_count lagging.
Jordan: Support: customer said they hit refresh and got a billing "preview" then an invoice. So UX confusion too.
Priya: Are provisional IDs tied to session token or to request_id? We should dedupe by request_id ideally.
Alex: Right now provisional keyed by session_id + offset. Toolcalls keyed by request_id. On reconnect we sometimes generate a new session_id or reuse—edge cases cause duplicate ownership.
Sam: Proposed short-term: when final charge is created, scan for provisional entries with same request_id and reduce them (provisional -> settled). Long-term: make provisional ownership include request_id when available.
Priya: Long-term sounds correct. Short-term patch: add dedupe pass in billing worker that merges by request_id and token range. Any objections? Need to ship before EOD.
Kim: Also add an alert on "provisional_unmatched > 5/min for same acct" and dashboard tile in Billing -> Anomalies.
Alex: Two other gotchas: toolcall truncation. If the client truncates stream due to TTL, we might emit provisional then later final with fewer tokens since truncation trimmed suffix — reconciliation fails because prefix capture uses original offset. Need to normalize token counts at commit time.
Sam: Example of mismatch:
```
provisional tokens=250 (prefix capture)
client truncates early -> final tokens=120
billing logs: provisional(250) + final(120) => double-charge
```
Priya: For truncation, final should annotate truncated=true and worker should decrement provisional by difference. We can implement that within billing reconciliation.
Jordan: Can we update console to show "provisional pending" label and hover to explain provisional semantics? Customer confused.
Kim: Will add the dashboard card and an annotation explaining provisional lifecycle.
Priya: Risk: if we aggressively merge provisional earlier, might undercharge on actual retries. Need safe window; propose 20s provisional TTL and require final before TTL to not double-count. Thoughts?
Alex: 20s seems okay, but streaming can be long-tail. Maybe extend only for sessions flagged as toolcall-in-flight. Set TTL to 60s for those, 20s otherwise.
Sam: I'll open a quick PR to add request_id tagging to provisional events and add dedupe worker patch. @Alex can you add the TTL flag logic in runtime?
Alex: on it. I'll also add a small tracing tag "billing.request_id" for every toolcall/stream handshake.
ledger-bot: Reconciliation run scheduled: job_id=r-20260318-9 queued; will emit report when done.
Priya: Thanks. @Sam can you assign the follow-ups in the ticket? We should coordinate with Console UX for the tooltip.
Sam: created ticket INF-8763 and added tasks for billing dedupe, runtime tag, TTL tweak, dashboard tile. Linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-8763
Jordan: I'll follow up with the customer, explain workaround: refresh invoice and mention we're reconciling.
Sam: Great, keep me posted. :thumbsup:
